title: Avatar: Seven Havens Just Confirmed Two More Seasons
content: Today marks the first time in twelve years that a new animated TV series in the Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise has arrived, as the first three episodes of Avatar: Seven Havens have officially arrived on Paramount+.
author: ComicBook

title: Avatar Studios Confirms New Series for Fan-Favorite Avatar (First Look Revealed)
content: Straight from New York Comic Con, Avatar: The Last Airbender co-creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko have confirmed that the franchise is expanding yet again. Fresh off the success of Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender , the team at Avatar Studios has been steadily expanding the series to give it an even…

title: Manga 'Hotaru no Yomeiri' Gets Live-Action Adaptation in 2027
content: Television broadcast company Fuji TV announced a live-action adaptation of Oreco Tachibana 's Hotaru no Yomeiri ( Firefly Wedding ) web manga on Saturday, revealing an announcement promotional video. The live-action series is scheduled to premiere on Fuji TV in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Casshern R Manga Listed as Ending With 3rd Volume
content: Retailers are listing the third compiled book volume of Satoshi Shiki 's Casshern R manga — the adaptation of Tatsunoko Production 's Shinzō Ningen Casshan original television anime — as the final volume. The volume will ship on December 18.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Highly Anticipated Ghost of Tsushima Anime Gets Bad News
content: Earlier this year, at a press conference held by Crunchyroll , it was announced that Sucker Punch’s Ghost of Tsushima video game would receive a new anime adaptation titled Ghost of Tsushima: Legends . It was exciting news, and fans were thrilled to see another video game franchise receive an expanded vision.
author: ComicBook

title: WEBTOON to Launch New Marvel Comics App in November
content: WEBTOON Entertainment announced on October 5 it is partnering with Marvel to launch a new Marvel Comics app on November 16, offering digital access to Marvel's library of current and classic comics.
author: ANN

title: The Ghost of Bongcheon-Dong Horror Webtoon Gets Live-Action Film Adaptation
content: Horang's horror webtoon The Ghost of Bongcheon-Dong is being adapted into a live-action film. Lotte Entertainment announced on October 7 that Arin — a member of K-pop girl group OH MY GIRL — and Chan-young Yoon will star in the film. Production began on October 5.
author: ANN

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Drops to #4, Star Detective Precure! Film to #5 in Japan
content: Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, dropped from #2 to #4 in its 11th weekend in Japan's box office from last Friday to Sunday. The film earned 178,447,600 yen (about US$1.12 million).
author: ANN

title: How I Became King by Eating Monsters Novels Get TV Anime by White Fox in 2027
content: Anime studio WHITE FOX announced on Friday it is producing a television anime adaptation of Daken 's How I Became King by Eating Monsters ( Monster no Niku wo Kutteitara Ōi ni Tsuita Ken ) light novel series. The anime will debut in 2027.
author: ANN

title: White Fox Produces 'Monster no Niku wo Kutte Itara Oui ni Tsuita Ken' TV Anime Adaptation for 2027
content: Production company King Records opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Daken 's Monster no Niku wo Kutte Itara Oui ni Tsuita Ken ( How I Became King by Eating Monsters ) light novel on Friday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured).
